Feature: Prescription System

  Scenario: System is self-contained
    Given the system is running with Django 2.0 and MySQL
    When a chemist logs in to the system
    Then the system displays the prescription and invoice for the chemist

  Scenario: Only emails are sent to patients
    Given a patient is registered in the system
    When a prescription is generated for the patient
    Then an email is sent to the patient with the prescription and invoice

  Scenario: Interface with Payment Gateway
    Given the system is integrated with the current standard Payment Gateway
    When a patient pays for a prescription using a debit/credit card or net banking
    Then the payment is processed successfully

  Scenario: Secure payment acceptance
    Given a patient is logged in to the system
    When the patient clicks the "Pay" button for a prescription
    Then the payment is accepted securely

  Scenario Outline: Browser and OS support
    Given the system is running on <browser> and <os>
    When a patient accesses the system
    Then the system displays the prescription and invoice correctly

    Examples:
      | browser    | os          |
      | Google Chrome | Windows 10  |
      | Mozilla Firefox | macOS High Sierra |
      | Safari | Linux Ubuntu  |
      | Edge | Windows 7  |

  Scenario Outline: Error paths - invalid login
    Given the system is running with Django 2.0 and MySQL
    When a chemist logs in to the system with an invalid username and password
    Then the system displays an error message

    Examples:
      | username | password |
      | invalid | invalid  |
      | invalid | valid    |
      | valid   | invalid  |

  Scenario Outline: Error paths - payment failure
    Given the system is integrated with the current standard Payment Gateway
    When a patient pays for a prescription using a debit/credit card or net banking
    Then the payment is declined

    Examples:
      | card type | card number | expiration date |
      | Debit Card | 1234-5678-9012-3456 | 2025-12-31 |
      | Credit Card | 9876-5432-1098-7654 | 2023-06-30 |
      | Net Banking | invalid account number | invalid date |

    Then the email contains the full prescription and invoice details

    When the user accesses the prescription and payment system
    Then the system displays an error message indicating unsupported browser

  Scenario: Edge cases
